entities.summary: The Palais du Rhin, the former Kaiserpalast, is a building situated in the German (north-east) quarter of Strasbourg (Neustadt), dominating the Place de la République with its massive dome. A huge building, it and the surrounding gardens, as well as the neighbouring stables, are an outstanding landmark of 19th-century German architecture.
